run_single_scenario: run a single scenario in a container using gaia2-runner with a specified image and judge model
run_dataset_scenarios: run multiple scenarios from a dataset directory or HuggingFace dataset with configurable concurrency and pass-at-N support
run_from_config: run a scenario or dataset from a TOML config file with optional dry-run and retry modes
generate_trace_viewer: generate trace viewer HTML from existing run artifacts in an output directory
serve_trace_viewer: serve a live trace viewer HTTP server that auto-regenerates on new results
